body:
Two findings a P5 identity lens raised on T139's diff. Neither blocked that merge. Both are real.

ONE: ONE NAME, TWO CLOCKS. `GatewayOptions.renderSpawnTimeoutMs` bounds the SERVER's worker_threads
start. `ArtifactCoordinates.renderSpawnTimeoutMs` bounds the BROWSER TAB's Worker start, and it is
set from the hard constant ARTIFACT_SPAWN_TIMEOUT_MS. The two are not wired together and should not
be: the page's clock is genuinely the device's.

The defect is the shared identifier on an operator-facing surface. An operator sets
`renderSpawnTimeoutMs: 2000` on the Gateway, packs an artifact, reads `coordinates.renderSpawnTimeoutMs`,
and gets 10000. Nothing is broken. The name answers a question it was not asked, which is H6's shape.
A distinct name -- `pageSpawnTimeoutMs` -- removes the ambiguity and costs nothing.

TWO: THE ANONYMOUS FAN HOLDS ITS SLOTS LONGER. Splitting the clocks moved the public door's
worst-case slot hold from renderTimeoutMs (500ms default) to renderSpawnTimeoutMs + renderTimeoutMs
(10500ms default). With the default cap of 16, sustained host contention can pin the anonymous fan
for ten seconds at a time where it used to recycle in half a second.

This is the right SHAPE -- gateway.ts names the consequence and makes the number operator-settable,
which is what a knob is for -- but the DEFAULT moved and no rail measures the new worst case. The
question to answer is whether 10s of spawn ceiling belongs on the anonymous door at all, or whether
that door deserves a tighter one than the token door. Spawn measures the host either way; what
differs is who pays for a slow host, and on the public door the payer is every other stranger.

RAILS: (a) a rail that the artifact coordinate and the gateway option are separately settable and
separately reported, under whatever names the rename settles on; (b) a rail measuring the public
door's worst-case slot hold against the numbers actually configured, so the default cannot move
again without a red bar.
title: renderSpawnTimeoutMs names two different clocks, and the public door's worst-case slot hold grew 20x
